patterns.pattern: ^You are now a member of the (\w+) class\.
With an ear-splitting roar, you rear back your draconic head and scream out your triumph.
You are not in Dragon form.

name: Air Lord/Lady/Fae

patterns.pattern: On and on, your soul cascades upon the currents that now sustain your form.

script:
if Legacy then

  if not gmcp.Char.Status.class:match('Elemental') then return end


  Legacy.Curing.Defs.temp = {defences = {}, keepup = {}}
  if Legacy.Curing.Defs["Air Elemental Lord"] or Legacy.Curing.Defs["Air Elemental Lady"] or Legacy.Curing.Defs["Air Elemental Fae"]  then
    if gmcp.Char.Status.gender == 'male' then
      Dset('Air Elemental Lord')
    elseif gmcp.Char.Status.gender == 'female' then
      Dset('Air Elemental Lady')
    elseif gmcp.Char.Status.gender == 'fae' then
      Dset('Air Elemental Fae')
    end
  else
    Legacy.bigEcho("This is the First time you are using this Class!", "SeaGreen" ,"red") 
    Legacy.bigEcho("Please use 'keepup' to set up your defences", "SeaGreen", "red")
    if gmcp.Char.Status.gender == 'male' then
      Dset('Air Elemental Lord')
      Legacy.Curing.Defs["Air Elemental Lord"] = table.deepcopy(Legacy.Curing.Defs.legacy)
    elseif gmcp.Char.Status.gender == 'female' then
      Dset('Air Elemental Lady')
      Legacy.Curing.Defs["Air Elemental Lady"] = table.deepcopy(Legacy.Curing.Defs.legacy)
    elseif gmcp.Char.Status.gender == 'fae' then
      Dset('Air Elemental Fae')
      Legacy.Curing.Defs["Air Elemental Fae"] = table.deepcopy(Legacy.Curing.Defs.legacy)      
    end  
  end
end
send('curing on')
